speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF). The clinical picture of progressive dyspnea, dry cough, restrictive lung function with low DLCO, and orthopnea, combined with the initial X-ray findings of interstitial markings, strongly supports this diagnosis despite the confusing CT report. We should proceed with a referral for surgical lung biopsy or multidisciplinary discussion to confirm the specific subtype and initiate antifibrotic therapy.
